channel.description: Latest articles from Bainbridge Island Review (bainbridgereview.com)

item.title: New bicycle traffic improvements coming to Winslow Way - Bainbridge Island Review
item.description: Another traffic flow update is coming to the busiest intersection in Winslow. There could be more where that came from.

item.title: Pitching leads Spartans to first league win over Olympic - Bainbridge Island Review
item.description: The reigning 2A state champion Bainbridge Spartans beat the Olympic Trojans 4-1 in their Olympic League season opener March 17 at the Kitsap County Fairgrounds.

item.title: Over 50 animals seized at home near Poulsbo, KHS reopens - Bainbridge Island Review
item.description: On March 17, the Kitsap County Sheriff’s Office and Kitsap Humane Society’s Animal Control Officers seized over 50 animals from a home in unincorporated Poulsbo.

item.title: BHS Spartronics defeats world-champ robot in first match of season - Bainbridge Island Review
item.description: Competition season is off to a strong start for Bainbridge High School’s robotics team, Spartronics.

item.title: BI girls’ middle school basketball team wins state title - Bainbridge Island Review
item.description: The Bainbridge Roots eighth-grade girls basketball team captured the Washington Middle School State Championship March 15 in Spokane, winning the Silver Division (2A).

item.title: Kaye Eileen Caskey Gough - Bainbridge Island Review
BHS track dominates across the board in first league meet - Bainbridge Island Review
item.description: The Bainbridge Spartans beat the Sequim Wolves and North Mason Bulldogs in their first Olympic League track meet of the season March 19 at Bainbridge High School, securing top finishes in most events.

item.title: Free music education program for youth seeks new home in NK - Bainbridge Island Review
item.description: Kids in Concert, the only free youth music education program in Kitsap County, must find a new home by Aug. 1 or risk closure.

item.title: Letters to the editor - Bainbridge Island Review
Bainbridge soccer off to fast start this season, beats P.A. 4-0 - Bainbridge Island Review
item.description: The Bainbridge Spartans boys soccer team (3-0) beat the Port Angeles Roughriders (3-1) 4-0 at home March 20, putting them near the top of the Olympic League standings early on in the season.

item.title: Helpline House’s expanded facility expected to open in June - Bainbridge Island Review
item.description: Bainbridge Island’s Helpline House is hoping to open its new facility by June.

item.title: Student Conservation Corps, Trails Crew essential during summer - Bainbridge Island Review
item.description: Summer is a big season for the park districts. Warm weather means more parkgoers, more plant growth, and more time for maintenance and volunteering to keep park facilities in tip-top shape.

item.title: Social-emotional learning program demonstrated at BI schools - Bainbridge Island Review
item.description: At the March 12 Bainbridge Island School District board meeting, director of student services Annalisa Sanchez shared a presentation on last year’s efforts to improve the district’s Multi-Tiered System of Support for social and emotional behavior. The program is a catchall term to describe how a school district teaches students about emotional regulation and social connection, through school policies, staff training, intervention plans for students, data collection and district culture.

item.title: BI Council reviews mobility report to address transportation gaps - Bainbridge Island Review
item.description: The Bainbridge Island City Council reviewed a report March 17 that aims to improve mobility for islanders and provide recommendations to address transportation access gaps.
